When looking for a carry-on with a built-in battery or charging setup, **airline compliance** is key: major carriers require the battery to be **easily removable** and under 100 Wh if it happens to end up checked at the gate.[[1]](https://www.travelandleisure.com/style/travel-bags/smart-luggage-with-removable-battery)[[2]](https://elalausa.com/blogs/articles/which-airlines-allow-electric-suitcases-full-list-for-2026)

- **Great for:** Sleek modern aesthetics and seamless device charging on the go.[[1]](https://www.travelandleisure.com/style/travel-bags/smart-luggage-with-removable-battery)



---

- **Why it wins:** The pioneer of modern smart luggage, Away features an optional/removable battery tucked neatly under the handle base. It packs an interior compression system and a hidden laundry bag. *(Note: Be sure to select the model with the ejectable battery option).*

Backed by an industry-leading lifetime guarantee.
- **Great for:** Frequent flyers who want softside expandability and a bag that lasts forever.



---

- **Great for:** Hyper-organized packers who hate unpacking at every hotel stop.

#### Quick Buying & Airline Checklist

- **Removable Battery Only:** Never buy smart luggage with a **non-removable** battery. If an airline forces you to gate-check the bag, non-compliant bags will be rejected or forced into the trash.[[1]](https://elalausa.com/blogs/articles/which-airlines-allow-electric-suitcases-full-list-for-2026)
- **Watt-Hour (Wh) Rating:** Keep your power bank under 100 Wh (standard for almost all airline carry-on and safety rules).[[1]](https://www.travelandleisure.com/style/travel-bags/smart-luggage-with-removable-battery)[[2]](https://elalausa.com/blogs/articles/which-airlines-allow-electric-suitcases-full-list-for-2026)
- **USB-C Support:** Look for modern packs that output USB-C Power Delivery (PD) so you can actually fast-charge phones, tablets, or small laptops rather than trickle-charging.
